Name: Matching Tools - Iridium Scythe
Author: Wumbuzz
Description:
You grinded hard for all your tools and weapons to be iridium but the Golden Scythe is messing up your color scheme?
This mod replaces the Golden Scythe with an [b]Iridium Scythe[/b] to match.

...


That's it. It turns the Golden Scythe into a cool iridium-purple. [b]Aesthetic! ✨[/b]

[/b]If you want your Copper Pan to match as well, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10569]Matching Tools - Copper Pan and hat[/url].


[quote]My name is Iridium Scythe, Scythes of Scythes
Look on my scything, ye Mighty, and despair![/quote]

[u][b]Troubleshooting

[/b][/u][b]Q: My Scythe is still silver-/iron-colored![/b]
[b]A[/b]: This mod only turns the Golden Scythe into an Iridium Scythe. The regular Scythe (which you get at the beginning of the game) stays in its original state. The Golden Scythe is a mid- to end-game item, not the starter version of the Scythe.

[b]Q: My Scythe looks Iridium, but the description still says "Golden Scythe"![/b]
[b]A:[/b] Unfortunately, it's only possible to change the name when you install this mod [b][u]before[/u][/b] acquiring the Golden Scythe. If you install the mod while already owning the Golden Scythe, the item description will still call it "Golden Scythe". But hey, look at that fancy purple color!

Downloads.Description: Simply unpack in your SDV mods folder to enable the mod.
